title: advance_ring ring_index increment could overflow on 32-bit with modified EXPANDING_RING
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs
Line: 282

Issue: The check `self.ring_index + 1 >= EXPANDING_RING.len()` performs addition before comparison. While safe with the current EXPANDING_RING length of 3, if EXPANDING_RING were extended to usize::MAX elements (theoretically), ring_index + 1 could overflow.

Trigger: Only if EXPANDING_RING is modified to have more elements than fit in usize and ring_index reaches usize::MAX - unlikely in practice.

Impact: Extremely low - only affects a theoretical future change. Current code is safe.

Suggested fix: Use `self.ring_index >= EXPANDING_RING.len() - 1` or `self.ring_index.checked_add(1).map_or(true, |n| n >= EXPANDING_RING.len())` for defensive coding. This is a P3 polish item, not a real bug.
close_reason: Invalid: Finding self-admits it is theoretical and 'not a real bug'. EXPANDING_RING has 3 elements, ring_index bounded by advance_ring check, max value is 2. Overflow impossible without changing constants to usize::MAX elements.
